headline: Executive order sets which Justice Department officials would act as Attorney General if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order lays out an order of succession inside the Department of Justice. It names which officials would step in to perform the Attorney General's duties if the Attorney General and other top leaders are absent, have died, or otherwise cannot do the job. Only a title was provided, so details such as the exact list of officials are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials are placed in a set order to temporarily take over the Attorney General's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 9, 2017; the source does not state a separate effective date.
